markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set and reliability support this, but the second model and similar cases disagree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%, InSitu <1% | Sharply peaked |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top class differs |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Invasive | Neighbors non-invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland/tubule formation** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules; concept-model association with invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score well above typical · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Score well below typical; concept-model term is positive · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 8) · ↑ invasive · Score elevated; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion drops invasive logit 0.54 beyond random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect classifier use. Leans on Unreliable mitoses and normal lobules (0/20 each).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampling degradation distorted nuclear texture; reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- The second model (MUSK) is right; similar cases are all non-invasive.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 7**: lowest invasive probability (7%, 35%, 22%); look for benign tissue.
2. **Regions 0, 9, 11**: top-scoring pleomorphism; confirm true atypia, not resampling artifact.
3. **Regions 0, 8**: mitosis score peaks; count mitoses directly, concept failed spot check.
